title: bundlr
tagline: bundlr can create on-chain loot boxes/bundles which can be redeemed and traded, built for WEB3 Games
description: Bundlr enables web3 games and artists to create bundles or loot boxes that can be redeemed and traded. Bundles can contain ERC721 and ERC20 tokens as pools that can be claimed by the owners, also these bundles can be reused once the pool is updated by the collection creator. happy un-bundling;
how_its_made: Bundlr is built using react for frontend and solidity. The Bundles are ERC721 tokens hence they can be used as normal NFT along with the redeem function. Once the collection owner approves the given pool, the bundles are created off-chain and then stored on-chain, and then the chainlink VRF randomly picks a bundle for you from the list;
